hardwareClasses.description: Older Intel Core i5 class CPU (roughly 8th-10th gen or similar laptop class).
hardwareClasses.selectionRule: Use the measured supported provider/model whose warm latency and accuracy fit the release budgets.

hardwareClasses.description: Modern Intel Core i5 class CPU (11th gen+ desktop/laptop class).
hardwareClasses.selectionRule: Keep the product default unless the current benchmark recommends another supported provider/model.

globalAppCoveragePolicy.runtimeTarget: Focused text control or window at the caret.
globalAppCoveragePolicy.baselineBehavior: Dictate Anywhere uses generic insertion paths for normal text surfaces and does not require app-specific integrations for baseline behavior.
globalAppCoveragePolicy.certifiedAppMatrixPolicy: Maintain a certified app matrix for release gating and evidence even though runtime behavior is generic.

knownLimitations.description: Lower-integrity insertion into elevated/admin targets can be blocked by UIPI unless the signed UIAccess path is enabled.
Secure or password fields are intentionally blocked or treated as unsafe.
Some controls do not expose a standard insertion surface and can reject both paste and typing paths.

compatibilityTiers.name: Tier 1
compatibilityTiers.label: Certified apps
compatibilityTiers.description: Certified apps must pass every release in scope and carry attached evidence.

compatibilityTiers.name: Tier 2
compatibilityTiers.label: Best-effort apps
compatibilityTiers.description: Best-effort apps use the generic runtime path and are tracked, but they are not release-blocking unless promoted.

compatibilityTiers.name: Tier 3
compatibilityTiers.label: Unsupported or blocked contexts
compatibilityTiers.description: Unsupported or blocked contexts must show deterministic UX messaging rather than implying support.
